# SE-ONE.SITE

> A centralized workspace, learning ecosystem, and talent portfolio for Software Engineering Gen 4 at RMUTL (Chiang Mai).

## 1. Overview
SE-ONE.SITE is a comprehensive platform designed specifically for software engineering students. It serves as an educational hub, an administrative tool for classes, a showcase for student projects, and a fully functional in-browser coding environment.

## 2. Core Subsystems

### 2.1 SE Job System (/sework)
A complete Learning Management System (LMS) and administrative dashboard.
- Features: Assignment submission tracking, announcements, schedule management, leaderboard, and user profile management.
- Access: Requires authentication. 

### 2.2 SE-ONE IDE (/code)
A professional-grade, in-browser coding playground.
- Engine: Powered by Monaco Editor (VS Code engine).
- Supported Languages: 
  - Web Native (HTML/CSS/JS) with Live Preview
  - React 18 JSX compiled via Babel Standalone
  - Native Python 3.11 execution via Pyodide (WebAssembly)
  - TypeScript compilation
  - Mock environments for C and Java
- Features: Real-time console interception, save/share snippet links, coding challenges, resizable UI, and theme switching.

### 2.3 Talent & Showcase Portfolio (/portfolio, /showcase)
Publicly accessible directories displaying the capabilities of SE Gen 4 students.
- Integrates with GitHub API to fetch real-time repository and follower stats.

## 3. Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 18, Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, Emotion (CSS-in-JS), Lucide Icons
- Backend/BaaS: Supabase (PostgreSQL, Auth, Realtime WebSockets)
- Deployment: Cloudflare Pages

## 4. Contact & Support
- Digital Guestbook: /guestbook
- Support & Ticketing: /support (Integrates with Discord Webhooks for real-time admin alerts)
